review_scope: versioned EOF deployment identity and consumers only

findings.issue: compile(str) would ignore byte-level source encoding declarations and could miss invalid original raw imports
findings.resolution: v2 validates raw, universal-newline-normalized and canonical UTF-8 bytes using compile and AST; conflicting/non-UTF8 encoding declarations reject; v1 unchanged

findings.issue: A strict overall source hash did not prove stale v2 deployment records described the actual local EOF bytes
findings.resolution: collection v2 freeze/precharge/first prepare validate physical original source identity and managed inventory; legacy recovery bypasses mutable current source
findings.verified_by: CLI agent tests plus read-only consumer review; independent integration verifies analogous stage2 strict behavior

findings.issue: Non-scalar verification_mode could raise TypeError; schema-only summary checks did not bind declared counts to admitted files
findings.resolution: closed mode type validation and original-manifest count/hash/mode binding added

findings.issue: CollectionTaskBridge initially looked up engineering/admitted-inputs instead of collection/admitted-inputs and skipped source-summary binding
findings.resolution: correct namespace required; new source-policy summary without original admission fails closed

findings.issue: An existing collection generated input was treated as a forbidden implementation file in v2 engineering PROJECT source readback
findings.resolution: v2 engineering readback separately counts and ignores that generated content; it never satisfies the independent engineering input hash; v1 behavior retained

limitations: Tests refer to the source SHA snapshot in independent_review_result.json, not a final committed reviewer-approved source version
